posts.author: Midona018
posts.body:
I started my own tileset style. There is only Forest tiles for now, but feel free to suggest anything you want ! This is entirely handmade so you can use it in any RPG Maker, but they are formatted for MV/MZ.
Using conditions :
Do not repost
the resources, create a link to this thread.
Do not repost edits
of my resources without my approval (send me a DM or post on my profile)
Free for
non-commercial use
Free for
commercial use
as long as I get a
free copy of your game.
Credit Midona018
The A1 autotiles can be used as is in MZ but you will need to edit them by adding a floor or a wall behind them in order to use them in MV.
I would love to see screenshots of your maps !
